scripts.architecture:check: node scripts/check-package-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-visual-architecture.mjs && node scripts/check-union-exhaustiveness.mjs
scripts.clean: find packages -type d -name dist -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find packages -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -delete && rm -rf dist
scripts.build: tsc -b tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-test-fixtures.mjs && node scripts/runtime-build-manifest.mjs --write
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run docs:check && npm run authoring:anti-leak && npm run architecture:check && npm run rojo:check && npm run runtime-build:check && npm run catalog:layout:check && npm run catalog:workers:test && npm run neural:workers:test && node --test-concurrency=4 --test dist/test/*.test.js && npm run plugin:test
scripts.plugin:test: find packages/roblox/plugin/src -name '*.luau' -print0 | xargs -0 luau-compile --only-parse && node scripts/check-plugin-ui.mjs && lune run packages/roblox/plugin/test/verify-hardening.luau
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run plugin:build
